headings.title: Creation of department and director appointment
headings.reviewNote: Creates the department of economic development headed by a director appointed by the governor with senate advice and consent.

headings.title: Transfer of regulatory commissions to department
headings.reviewNote: Transfers the public service commission and administrative hearing commission to the department by type III transfer and coordinates staff and equipment.

headings.title: Transfer of office of public counsel
headings.reviewNote: Transfers the office of public counsel to the department by type III transfer and provides general revenue funding.

headings.title: Employment of staff by public service commission
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the public service commission to employ staff for general counsel functions not relating to public representation.

headings.title: Transfer of tourism commission to division
headings.reviewNote: Transfers tourism commission powers, duties, and functions to the newly created division of tourism by type III transfer.

headings.title: Transfer and abolition of community affairs department
headings.reviewNote: Transfers community affairs powers and duties to the department by type I transfer, abolishes the department of community affairs, and authorizes subunits.

headings.title: Assignment of Missouri housing development commission
headings.reviewNote: Assigns the Missouri housing development commission to the department as a body corporate and politic and state instrumentality.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority and statutory compliance
headings.reviewNote: Conditions effectiveness of department rules on chapter 536 compliance and nonseverability provisions, voiding rules proposed or adopted after August 28, 2008, if legislative review powers are held unconstitutional.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes department of economic development, governs director appointment, transfers agencies including public service and tourism, and provides rulemaking authority.

headings.title: Required terms in economic incentive contracts
headings.reviewNote: Requires department contracts for grants, loans, tax credits, or services to specify purpose, incentive details, public purpose, goals, and obligations.

headings.title: Repayment and return of misspent proceeds
headings.reviewNote: Mandates return of unused proceeds and repayment of expended incentives upon noncompliance or misuse of funds.

headings.title: Governing law for incentive contracts
headings.reviewNote: Establishes that financial assistance and incentive contracts are governed by and enforceable through contract law.

headings.title: Annual economic incentives report requirements
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to submit and publish an annual report detailing awarded incentives, public purposes, jobs created, and enforcement actions.

entries.reviewSummary: Mandates terms for economic incentive agreements, repayment remedies for noncompliance, governing contract law, and annual reporting requirements.

headings.title: Energy research, conservation, and policy duties
headings.reviewNote: Vests the department with powers to analyze energy policies, cooperate with governmental agencies, monitor research, evaluate energy sources, and develop conservation programs.

headings.title: Appropriation requirement and agreement authority
headings.reviewNote: Conditions expenditures on specific legislative appropriation and authorizes agreements, contracts, and grants with public and private entities.

entries.reviewSummary: Specifies department duties regarding state energy planning, alternative energy assessment, conservation programs, and authorized cooperative agreements.

headings.title: Establishment of small business development centers fund
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the Missouri small business development centers fund in the state treasury to receive appropriations, gifts, and grants.

headings.title: Authorized fund payments and matching distribution
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes state treasurer payments to the host entity for distribution matching federal and private funds under contracts.

headings.title: Financial agreement with host entity and federal matching
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to enter into a financial agreement with the host entity upon appropriation, notify the state treasurer to disburse funds, and allows state or local moneys to qualify for matching federal moneys.

headings.title: Director administrative control and exclusive use
headings.reviewNote: Grants the director administrative control over fund moneys for exclusive statutory use and requires the host entity to provide distribution controls.

headings.title: Non-lapse, investment earnings, and abolition reversion
headings.reviewNote: Exempts year-end fund balances from section 33.080 lapse, directs state treasurer investment with earnings credited to the fund, and reverts moneys to general revenue if the fund is abolished.

entries.reviewSummary: Creates the Missouri small business development centers fund, governing appropriations, host entity matching distributions, financial agreements, administrative control, and non-lapse investment rules.

headings.title: Interagency supply of statistical data and materials
headings.reviewNote: Permits the director to call upon other government departments and agencies to supply statistical data, program reports, and assistance needed for sections 620.1000 to 620.1007.

headings.title: Publication and cost reimbursement for data
headings.reviewNote: Permits the director to collect, analyze, and distribute relevant program information free of charge or by sale at cost, and to arrange and pay for printing and binding.

entries.reviewSummary: Directs governmental agencies to supply statistical materials to the director and authorizes publication with cost recovery fees.

headings.title: Establishment of business extension service team fund
headings.reviewNote: Creates the Business Extension Service Team Fund as a revolving fund for grants or loans to qualified community development projects in specified cities targeted to economically blighted urban districts, allowing up to ten percent for city administrative costs and defining economically blighted urban districts.

headings.title: Direct contracts with community development corporations
headings.reviewNote: Permits the department to use a percentage of fund moneys to directly contract with community development corporations under section 135.400 for job training or job creation and retention in qualifying areas.

headings.title: Exemption from general revenue lapse
headings.reviewNote: Protects unexpended fund balances from lapsing to general revenue at the end of the fiscal year.

entries.reviewSummary: Creates the business extension service team fund, governing allowed expenditures for qualified projects and non-lapse protections.

headings.title: Contracts with regional nonprofits to select teams
headings.reviewNote: Permits the department to directly contract with regional not-for-profit organizations to assist regional offices and businesses in selecting team members and consultants for feasibility studies and productivity assessments.

headings.title: Criteria for recommending productivity assessments or studies
headings.reviewNote: Requires business extension service teams to consider business viability, joint management-labor commitment, and job retention and advancement potential when recommending productivity assessments or feasibility studies.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes department contracts with regional not-for-profit organizations to select business extension team members and consultants, and sets criteria for recommending productivity assessments.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority for business extension teams
headings.reviewNote: Grants the department authority to promulgate administrative rules to implement the business extension service team program.

headings.title: Confidentiality of business assistance information
headings.reviewNote: Provides that information relating to requests for assistance from business extension service teams shall be confidential.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes administrative rulemaking and protects the confidentiality of business assistance requests.

headings.title: Establishment of new jobs fund
headings.reviewNote: Creates the New Jobs Fund in the state treasury as a revolving fund administered by the department of economic development.

headings.title: Appropriation for early-stage Missouri business investments
headings.reviewNote: Permits a one-time five-million-dollar appropriation to make matched debt or equity investments in early-stage Missouri businesses, with state investment capped at forty percent of total investment.

headings.title: Exemption of fund balances from general revenue lapse
headings.reviewNote: Exempts moneys remaining in the new jobs fund at fiscal year end from section 33.080 lapse to general revenue.

headings.title: Contingent effective date upon constitutional amendment
headings.reviewNote: Conditions effectiveness on voter approval of an eighty-seventh general assembly Article III constitutional amendment allowing direct state investments in businesses; source footnote notes the eighty-seventh general assembly did not take action on subsection 4.

entries.reviewSummary: Creates the New Jobs Fund revolving fund for matched debt or equity investments in early-stage Missouri businesses, exempts balances from lapse, and conditions effectiveness on voter approval of a constitutional amendment.

headings.title: Definitions for research tax credits
headings.reviewNote: Defines additional qualified research expenses, minority business enterprise, Missouri qualified research and development equipment, qualified research expenses, small business, taxpayer, and women's business enterprise.

headings.title: Authorization of qualified research tax credit
headings.reviewNote: Permits tax credits up to six and one-half percent of excess qualified research expenses for 2001–2004, and beginning January 1, 2023, fifteen percent (or twenty percent with a Missouri college or university) of additional qualified research expenses, capped at two hundred percent of the three-year average.

headings.title: Application procedure and director certification
headings.reviewNote: Outlines taxpayer application requirements, department certification timeline, and issuance of tax credit certificates.

headings.title: Transfer and assignment of tax credits
headings.reviewNote: Governs transfer, sale, and assignment of tax credits, notarized endorsements, and flow-through entity allocations.

headings.title: Sales and use tax exemption
headings.reviewNote: Exempts purchases of Missouri qualified research and development equipment from state and local sales and use taxes.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority and legislative review
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to adopt administrative rules subject to chapter 536 and nonseverability clauses.

headings.title: Annual aggregate tax credit caps
headings.reviewNote: Establishes annual aggregate credit limitations, minority, women, and small business reservations, single-taxpayer caps, and pro-rata distributions.

headings.title: Sunset provisions under Missouri sunset act
headings.reviewNote: Sets automatic sunset on December 31, six years after August 28, 2022 (December 31, 2028), twelve-year sunset if reauthorized, and termination on December 31 of the following calendar year (December 31, 2029).

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes qualified research expense tax credits and sales tax exemptions, detailing application rules, transferability, caps, and sunset terms.

headings.title: Program loss reserve account set aside
headings.reviewNote: Requires originating financial institutions and borrowers to deposit matching percentages into a program loss reserve account.

headings.title: Department certification and matching transfer
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to verify loan certification and transfer matching or enhanced capital access program funds to the institution.

headings.title: Recovery of loan losses and claim assignment
headings.reviewNote: Permits financial institutions to recover loan losses from reserve accounts upon proof and requires assignment of loan rights to the department.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes program loss reserve account contributions, department matching transfers, and procedures for recovering loan losses.

headings.title: Prohibition on insider and related loans
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits participating financial institutions from making program loans to executive officers, directors, principal shareholders, or immediate family members.

headings.title: Definitions of immediate family and related interest
headings.reviewNote: Defines immediate family and related interest for purposes of insider loan prohibitions under the program.

entries.reviewSummary: Prohibits program loans to financial institution insiders and defines immediate family and related interest.

headings.title: Institution withdrawal and excess reserve withdrawal
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits withdrawing financial institutions from recovering set-aside contributions and permits the department to withdraw reserve amounts continuously exceeding enrolled loan balances for twenty-four consecutive months into the capital access program fund.

headings.title: Division of finance examination of reserve accounts
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the division of finance of the department of commerce and insurance to examine all program loss reserve accounts and conditions institution participation on agreeing to such examinations.

entries.reviewSummary: Bars withdrawing financial institutions from recovering set-aside contributions, permits department withdrawal of prolonged excess reserve balances, and requires division of finance examination access.

headings.title: Establishment of microenterprise loan program
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to establish a microenterprise loan program assisting small businesses and defines eligible microenterprise entities.

headings.title: Appointment and duties of oversight committee
headings.reviewNote: Requires the director to appoint a nine-member oversight committee chaired by the director or designee to assist in administering sections 620.1069 to 620.1081 and designate microenterprise loan programs and geographical boundaries.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the microenterprise loan program, defines microenterprises, and provides for an advisory oversight committee.

headings.title: Establishment of microenterprise loan fund
headings.reviewNote: Creates the microenterprise loan fund in the state treasury to receive state appropriations, loan repayments, and federal or private contributions.

headings.title: Reservation of funds for female-owned microenterprises
headings.reviewNote: Calls for diligent efforts to assure that at least thirty percent of fund moneys are available to and reserved for female-owned microenterprises.

entries.reviewSummary: Creates the microenterprise loan fund and reserves a percentage of available funds for female-owned microenterprises.

headings.title: Program establishment and ten-member advisory committee
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the Youth Opportunities and Violence Prevention Program and defines its ten-member director-appointed advisory committee, including private sector youth experts and at least one member under twenty-one.

headings.title: Youth opportunities and violence prevention fund
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the Youth Opportunities and Violence Prevention Fund in the state treasury administered by the department, permitting diverse funding sources and exempting year-end balances from section 33.080 lapse.

headings.title: Program criteria, evaluation, and high-crime priority
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department and advisory committee to establish section 135.460 tax credit criteria and evaluation methods prioritizing local community-based programs and areas with higher crime, violence, and poverty.

headings.title: Statewide information database operation
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to develop and operate a statewide database of youth violence prevention programs and resources.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the youth opportunities and violence prevention program, advisory committee, trust fund, and statewide database.

headings.title: Department allocation of moneys and limitations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to allocate moneys for approved youth programs and prescribes statutory funding limitations.

headings.title: Grant agreements, audits, and repayment remedies
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes contractual agreements, requires audits of grant recipients, and provides for repayment upon program noncompliance.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs department monetary allocations for youth programs, execution of grant agreements, audits, and repayment requirements.

headings.title: Establishment of Missouri film commission
headings.reviewNote: Creates the Missouri film commission within the department of economic development to promote the film industry.

headings.title: Commission membership and appointment process
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that the commission consists of five members with motion picture industry knowledge and experience appointed by the director of the department of economic development.

headings.title: Three-year staggered terms for commission members
headings.reviewNote: Sets three-year terms for appointed commission members, with initial appointments staggered into two three-year, two two-year, and one one-year terms.

headings.title: Reimbursement for member expenses
headings.reviewNote: Provides that commission members receive no compensation but shall be reimbursed for actual and necessary expenses incurred performing official duties.

headings.title: Duties and promotional objectives of commission
headings.reviewNote: Outlines the statutory duties of the commission to attract film production and enhance Missouri's media industry.

headings.title: Submission of recommendations and annual reporting
headings.reviewNote: Requires the commission to submit its recommendations by January first of each year, beginning January 1, 1998.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the Missouri film commission, defining membership, terms, expense reimbursement, promotional duties, and reporting requirements.

headings.title: Establishment and objectives of film office
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the office of the Missouri film commission to scout locations, promote the state, assist filmmakers, and coordinate services.

headings.title: Coordination with local film offices
headings.reviewNote: Requires the state film office to coordinate efforts with local film offices and tourism bureaus.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the office of the Missouri film commission, specifying promotional objectives and coordination with local film entities.

headings.title: Definitions for investment funds service corporations
headings.reviewNote: Defines department and director and incorporates income allocation definitions for investment funds service corporations.

headings.title: Annual election to compute Missouri income
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes certified investment funds service corporations to elect annually to compute state income under section 143.451 or the multistate tax compact.

headings.title: Mandatory income computation starting tax year 2020
headings.reviewNote: Requires certified corporations to compute Missouri derived income pursuant to section 143.455 for tax years beginning on or after January 1, 2020.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes income apportionment elections for investment funds service corporations and establishes mandatory computation under section 143.455 from 2020.

headings.title: Governor's agriculture advisory council creation
headings.reviewNote: Creates the seven-member advisory council within the department, specifying farmer representation and gubernatorial appointment.

headings.title: Duties regarding agricultural science and technology
headings.reviewNote: Specifies council duties to advise the governor on scientific developments, regulatory inquiries, long-term needs, biotechnology, and forestry.

headings.title: Member expense reimbursement without compensation
headings.reviewNote: Provides that council members serve without compensation but shall be reimbursed for reasonable travel and meeting expenses.

entries.reviewSummary: Creates the Governor's Advisory Council on Agriculture Science and Technology, outlining member selection, advisory duties, and expense reimbursement.

headings.title: Establishment of electronic commerce committee
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the advisory committee for electronic commerce within the department to advise state agencies on e-commerce matters.

headings.title: Committee composition and member appointment
headings.reviewNote: Provides for thirteen members appointed by the director, representing state agencies, diverse business sectors, and the public.

headings.title: Terms of office and expense reimbursement
headings.reviewNote: Sets two-year terms for committee members and authorizes reimbursement of actual and necessary expenses without compensation.

headings.title: Director leadership and department staffing
headings.reviewNote: Designates the director as chair and provides for department staffing and proxy leadership.

headings.title: Meeting locations and semiannual minimum frequency
headings.reviewNote: Directs the committee to meet at places and times designated by the director of economic development, but not less than twice per calendar year.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the Advisory Committee for Electronic Commerce, detailing membership, terms, director leadership, and minimum semiannual meeting requirements.

headings.title: Citation of Meet in Missouri Act
headings.reviewNote: Designates the statutory section as the Meet in Missouri Act.

headings.title: Definitions for major convention grants
headings.reviewNote: Defines director, eligible commission, eligible major convention event costs, fund, grant, major convention event, and major convention plan.

headings.title: Major economic convention event fund created
headings.reviewNote: Creates the major economic convention event in Missouri fund in the state treasury to hold appropriations and gifts.

headings.title: Grant payment, segregated account, and holding requirement
headings.reviewNote: Directs grant payment from the fund to an eligible commission upon compliance with subsection 5, requiring deposit into a segregated account held until after the event and submission of the subsection 7 report.

headings.title: Director approval requirement before disbursement
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits grant disbursement until the director approves a written major convention plan confirming applicant eligibility, event and disbursement dates within five years, out-of-state competition, but-for need, and positive net fiscal impact.

headings.title: Verification and disbursement of grant moneys
headings.reviewNote: Directs issuance of certificates of approval capping each grant at the lesser of fifty percent of hosting cost, positive net fiscal impact, or one million dollars, subject to annual appropriations capped at three million dollars.

headings.title: Post-event financial report and verification
headings.reviewNote: Requires grantees to submit written financial reports within one hundred eighty days documenting costs and attendance.

headings.title: Refunds returned to convention fund
headings.reviewNote: Directs that refunded grant moneys shall be deposited back into the major economic convention event fund.

headings.title: Sunset provisions under Missouri sunset act
headings.reviewNote: Establishes automatic sunset six years after August 28, 2022 (August 28, 2028) and termination on September 1 of the following year (September 1, 2029) under sections 23.250 to 23.298.

entries.reviewSummary: Enacts the Meet in Missouri Act, creating the convention event fund, detailing plan approvals, disbursements, reporting, and sunset terms.

headings.title: Citation of defense and energy independence act
headings.reviewNote: Designates the section as the Missouri Defense and Energy Independence Act.

headings.title: Definitions for critical materials incentives
headings.reviewNote: Defines critical materials, critical pharmaceuticals, department, MDFB, notice of intent, project facility, qualified company, qualified project costs, state tax liability, and tax credit.

headings.title: Tax credit authorization for critical materials
headings.reviewNote: For tax years beginning on or after January 1, 2027, authorizes nonrefundable, transferable tax credits with ten-year carryforward equal to twenty percent for five to fifteen million dollars in qualified project costs and twenty-five percent for fifteen million dollars or more; source footnote notes 'that' appears in original rolls.

headings.title: Annual aggregate cap on tax credits
headings.reviewNote: Limits the cumulative tax credits authorized under the section to forty million dollars annually.

headings.title: Notice of intent and department agreement
headings.reviewNote: Requires qualified companies to submit a notice of intent and enter into an agreement with the department before receiving credits.

headings.title: Foreign influence independence fund created
headings.reviewNote: Creates the grants for independence from foreign influence fund in the state treasury to support qualified projects.

headings.title: Grants for independence from foreign influence
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to implement grants for independence from foreign influence for qualified project costs, with MDFB serving as third-party administrator disbursing up to five hundred thousand dollars per application subject to appropriations.

headings.title: Promulgation of administrative rules
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to promulgate necessary administrative rules under chapter 536 with nonseverability provisions affecting rules proposed or adopted after August 28, 2026.

headings.title: Sunset provisions under Missouri sunset act
headings.reviewNote: Sets automatic program sunset on December 31, 2036, and termination on September 1, 2037, while preserving fulfillment of pre-sunset state obligations.

entries.reviewSummary: Enacts the Missouri Defense and Energy Independence Act, authorizing tax credits, creating a grant fund, and setting annual caps and sunset terms.

headings.title: Establishment of Missouri export development office
headings.reviewNote: Creates the Missouri export development office within the department to foster and promote international commerce.

headings.title: Powers and duties of export office
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes coordination with federal and private export financing programs, contact networks, exporter information dissemination, small and medium business assistance, technical assistance, studies, agriculture referrals, and annual reporting.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the Missouri Export Development Office within the department and outlines statutory functions to expand international trade.

headings.title: Department response timeline to notice of intent
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department to respond within thirty days with approval or rejection to a notice of intent (deemed approved upon nonresponse), gives preference to federal disaster areas, and governs multiple or concurrent project periods.

headings.title: Program exclusivity, withholding priority, and worker forfeiture
headings.reviewNote: Bars simultaneous listed tax credits at the same facility, credits other withholding programs first (issuing refundable credits if participating in job training), and mandates immediate forfeiture and repayment for knowingly hiring unauthorized workers; source footnotes note sections 135.900 to 135.906 were repealed in 2018 and Missouri works jobs training was renamed Missouri one start in 2019.

headings.title: Project categories and benefit tier calculations
headings.reviewNote: Defines project categories including small and expanding businesses, technology businesses, and high impact projects with wage thresholds.

headings.title: Annual reporting by qualified company
headings.reviewNote: Requires participating companies to provide annual reports documenting job creation, wages, and health insurance coverage.

headings.title: Calendar year aggregate tax credit cap
headings.reviewNote: Caps maximum calendar year annual tax credits issued for the entire program at eighty million dollars.

headings.title: Allocation of tax credits based on approval
headings.reviewNote: Directs annual tax credit allocation by approval date subject to actual payroll verification, expiring after two years if minimum thresholds are not achieved.

headings.title: Flow-through entity tax credit allocation
headings.reviewNote: Permits tax credits awarded to flow-through entities to be claimed by members, partners, or shareholders proportionally.

headings.title: Tax credit application against state taxes
headings.reviewNote: Allows tax credits to be claimed against chapter 143 and 148 taxes without carryforward within one year of the close of the taxable year for which issued, except under subsection 3(4).

headings.title: Transfer, sale, or assignment of credits
headings.reviewNote: Governs the transfer, sale, or assignment of tax credits by notarized endorsement filed with the department.

headings.title: Tax clearance verification with department of revenue
headings.reviewNote: Requires department verification of tax compliance through the department of revenue before issuing tax credits.

headings.title: Refund of excess tax credits
headings.reviewNote: Except under subsection 3(4), directs the director of revenue to issue a refund to the qualified company to the extent allowed tax credits exceed income tax liability.

headings.title: Employee credit for withheld payroll taxes
headings.reviewNote: Guarantees that employees of qualified companies receive full credit for statutory withholding taxes retained by employers.

headings.title: Severability of program statutory provisions
headings.reviewNote: Provides that invalidity of any provision of sections 620.1875 to 620.1890 shall not affect other valid statutory applications.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs Missouri Quality Jobs incentives, covering notice response times, benefit tiers, annual reporting, credit transfers, and tax clearance.

headings.title: Authority to charge tax credit fee
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to charge tax credit recipients up to two and one-half percent of credits issued, or four percent for credits under sections 253.545 to 253.559, exempting specified community and youth credits.

headings.title: Fee deposit and historic credit marketing allocation
headings.reviewNote: Directs all fees into the economic development advancement fund and dedicates thirty-seven and one-half percent of the four percent fee under sections 253.545 to 253.559 to business recruitment and marketing.

headings.title: Economic development advancement fund created
headings.reviewNote: Creates the economic development advancement fund in the state treasury to receive fee proceeds and gifts.

headings.title: Sources of economic development advancement fund
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that the fund consists of subsection 1 fees, federal or private gifts and grants, private activity bond fees, payments for department goods or services, and appropriations.

headings.title: Required allocation for marketing and development
headings.reviewNote: Mandates that at least fifty percent of fund moneys be appropriated for economic development marketing and business development.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes department fees on issued tax credits, creates the Economic Development Advancement Fund, and allocates marketing moneys.

headings.title: Citation of Manufacturing Jobs Act
headings.reviewNote: Designates the statutory section as the Manufacturing Jobs Act.

headings.title: Definitions for manufacturing jobs program
headings.reviewNote: Defines approval, capital investment, county average wage, department, facility, full-time job, NAICS, new job, new product, notice of intent, qualified manufacturing company, qualified supplier, retained job, statewide average wage, withholding period, and withholding tax.

headings.title: Department response timeline to notice of intent
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department to respond within thirty days to a manufacturing company or supplier notice of intent.

headings.title: Withholding retention for qualified manufacturing companies
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes qualified manufacturing companies, no earlier than January 1, 2012, to retain one hundred percent of withholding tax for ten years (new product) or fifty percent for seven years (modified or expanded product), with up to a twenty-four-month delay.

headings.title: Withholding retention for qualified suppliers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes qualified suppliers to retain all withholding tax from new jobs for three years, or five years if wages equal or exceed one hundred twenty percent of county average wage, while barring duplicate benefits under listed statutes; source footnote notes sections 135.900 to 135.906 were repealed in 2018.

headings.title: Annual program withholding tax limits
headings.reviewNote: Caps annual withholding tax retention at ten million dollars for any single qualified manufacturing company and fifteen million dollars in aggregate for all qualified manufacturing companies per calendar year.

headings.title: Program exclusivity, withholding coordination, and worker forfeiture
headings.reviewNote: Bars simultaneous listed tax incentives for the same jobs or capital improvement, credits other withholding programs first, and mandates forfeiture and repayment for knowingly hiring unauthorized workers; source footnotes note 2018 repeal of sections 135.900 to 135.906 and 2019 renaming to Missouri one start.

headings.title: Promulgation of administrative rules
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to promulgate rules to implement the program subject to chapter 536 and nonseverability clauses.

headings.title: Required agreement, investment clawback, and suspension option
headings.reviewNote: Requires a department agreement within six months of notice completion, imposing forfeiture and repayment with five percent interest for unmet two-year capital investment (with a discretionary three-year economic suspension) or discontinuation of new product manufacturing.

headings.title: Annual legislative report by department
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to provide an annual report to the general assembly detailing participating companies and retained taxes.

headings.title: Sunset provisions under Missouri sunset act
headings.reviewNote: Sets automatic program sunset on October 12, 2016 (twelve years if reauthorized) and termination on September 1 of the following calendar year (September 1, 2017) under section 23.253.

entries.reviewSummary: Enacts the Manufacturing Jobs Act, authorizing withholding retention for manufacturers and suppliers, with clawbacks, audits, and sunset terms.

headings.title: Definitions for Missouri works program
headings.reviewNote: Defines thirty-eight terms for sections 620.2000 to 620.2020, including average wage, commencement of operations, county average wage, full-time employee, new capital investment, new job, notice of intent, project facility, qualified company, qualified manufacturing company, qualified military project, and withholding tax.

headings.title: Applicability of life sciences research restrictions
headings.reviewNote: Establishes that the section and program are subject to the life sciences research restrictions in section 196.1127.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines terms for the Missouri Works program under sections 620.2000 to 620.2020 and incorporates section 196.1127 restrictions.

headings.title: Authorization of withholding tax retention
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes qualified companies creating new jobs to retain withholding taxes for five years, or six years for existing Missouri businesses, under general, rural area, or enhanced enterprise zone job and wage thresholds.

headings.title: Discretionary additional tax credit awards
headings.reviewNote: Permits the department to award additional discretionary tax credits based on local economic conditions and wage levels.

headings.title: Manufacturing capital investment tax credits
headings.reviewNote: Permits awarding tax credits beginning no earlier than January 1, 2023, for five years (with a five-year renewal for an additional two hundred fifty million dollars) to qualified manufacturing companies making at least five hundred million dollars in manufacturing capital investment within three years, capped at five million dollars per company and ten million dollars aggregate annually.

headings.title: Written agreement requirement for tax credits
headings.reviewNote: Requires qualified companies to enter into written agreements with the department before receiving tax credits.

headings.title: Alternative withholding benefits in lieu of credits
headings.reviewNote: Provides alternative five-year (or six-year for existing Missouri businesses) withholding retention and refundable tax credits equal to six or seven percent of new payroll for projects creating at least one hundred new jobs at one hundred twenty or one hundred forty percent of county average wage; source footnote notes 'sections' appears in original rolls.

headings.title: Additional tax credits supplementing alternative withholding
headings.reviewNote: Permits additional tax credits up to three percent of new payroll for five years (or six years for existing Missouri businesses) to companies qualifying under subsection 5, with total benefits capped at nine percent of new payroll per calendar year.

headings.title: Lump-sum tax credits for major investment projects
headings.reviewNote: Permits lump-sum tax credits up to nine percent of new payroll issued within one year for companies committing to ten-year capital investment and job creation at one hundred percent of county average wage, expiring June 30, 2025.

headings.title: Disqualification for prior site work or announcement
headings.reviewNote: Disqualifies projects where significant site work, equipment purchases, or public announcements occurred prior to proposal approval.

headings.title: Military project tax credits for development authorities
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes tax credits to industrial development authorities for qualified military projects based on civilian and military withholdings.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs Missouri Works program incentives, detailing withholding retention formulas, capital investment credits, and military project benefits.

headings.title: Eligibility criteria for capital investment tax credits
headings.reviewNote: Establishes eligibility criteria requiring proposal acceptance and thirty or fifty million dollars in capital investment within two years.

headings.title: Ineligibility of data storage centers
headings.reviewNote: Excludes certified data storage centers from qualifying for new capital investment tax credits under this section.

headings.title: Notice of intent submission and response procedure
headings.reviewNote: Requires qualified companies to submit a notice of intent and directs the department to respond within thirty days.

headings.title: Maximum percentage and timing of tax credits
headings.reviewNote: Caps credits at two and one-half percent of new capital investment made during the three-year period following notice of intent.

headings.title: Fiscal year cap and two-year expiration
headings.reviewNote: Subjects credits to the annual program cap and provides for expiration if minimum capital investment is not met in two years.

headings.title: Department evaluation factors for credit proposals
headings.reviewNote: Outlines factors considered by the department including company need, project size, jobs, wages, and state net fiscal benefit.

headings.title: Annual reporting by qualified company
headings.reviewNote: Requires participating companies to provide annual reports detailing new capital investments made and certified costs.

headings.title: Required terms of written project agreement
headings.reviewNote: Requires written agreements containing investment commitments, repayment remedies, and reporting covenants before credit issuance.

headings.title: Prohibition on simultaneous competing program benefits
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits a qualified company awarded tax credits under this section from simultaneously receiving benefits under sections 135.100 to 135.155, 620.2010, or 620.2015 for the same jobs, wages, or new capital investment.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs Missouri Works capital investment tax credits, establishing eligibility, notice procedures, caps, evaluation factors, written agreements, and prohibitions on simultaneous benefits.

headings.title: Relocation avoidance criteria and annual benefit cap
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes retention benefits where relocation to another state is likely and caps annual program benefits at six million dollars.

headings.title: Withholding retention terms and written agreement
headings.reviewNote: Allows retention of up to one hundred percent of withholding tax for ten years subject to county wage rules and net fiscal benefit limits.

headings.title: Eligibility conditions for jobs and capital investment
headings.reviewNote: Requires retaining at least fifty jobs for ten years and making new capital investment equal to half of offered benefits within three years.

headings.title: Department evaluation factors for awarding benefits
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department to evaluate statutory factors in section 620.2010 subsection 2 when awarding benefits under this section.

headings.title: Written agreement requirements and clawback terms
headings.reviewNote: Directs execution of a project agreement specifying committed retained jobs, payroll, new capital investment, and clawback provisions.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs Missouri Works job retention benefits to prevent interstate relocation, detailing benefit caps, eligibility thresholds, evaluation criteria, and written agreements.

headings.title: Department response timeline to benefit request
headings.reviewNote: Requires department proposal responses within five business days (fifteen for qualified manufacturing companies) and notice of intent decisions within thirty days (deemed approved upon nonresponse), including minority hiring plan review and multi-period rules.

headings.title: Coordination with other withholding and training programs
headings.reviewNote: Requires benefits under other state withholding programs to be credited first and directs issuance of refundable tax credits instead of withholding retention when a company participates in a withholding-based job training program.

headings.title: Annual compliance reporting by program beneficiaries
headings.reviewNote: Requires annual reporting on jobs, payroll, healthcare coverage, and capital investment by qualified companies and military projects.

headings.title: Withholding of benefits pending compliance documentation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to withhold benefit approvals until satisfied that proper eligibility documentation is provided.

headings.title: Compliance records and tax credit accountability act
headings.reviewNote: Requires approved companies and military projects to provide requested compliance records and subjects the program to the Tax Credit Accountability Act under sections 135.800 to 135.830 as a business recruitment tax credit.

headings.title: Forfeiture of benefits for unauthorized alien employment
headings.reviewNote: Provides that knowingly hiring unauthorized aliens forfeits program benefits and requires repayment of prior awards.

headings.title: Annual program tax credit authorization limits
headings.reviewNote: Establishes fiscal year aggregate tax credit caps, reserve funds, and rollover rules for the Missouri Works program.

headings.title: Annual aggregate withholding tax retention limits
headings.reviewNote: Caps the total annual withholding tax retained by all qualified companies across fiscal years.

headings.title: Allocation of tax credits based on approval
headings.reviewNote: Directs credit allocation by approval date and sets reservation mechanisms for pending projects.

headings.title: Application and transferability of tax credits
headings.reviewNote: Governs claiming tax credits against state income and financial institution taxes, with transferability provisions.

headings.title: Department of revenue tax clearance verification
headings.reviewNote: Requires verification of state tax compliance before issuing tax credits or permitting withholding retention.

headings.title: Refund of excess tax credits
headings.reviewNote: Directs the director of revenue to issue a refund to a qualified company to the extent allowed tax credits exceed chapter 143 or 148 tax liability.

headings.title: Employee credit for withheld payroll taxes
headings.reviewNote: Guarantees employees receive full credit for state income taxes withheld and retained by employers.

headings.title: Cessation of benefits under superseded programs
headings.reviewNote: Bars new benefits beginning August 28, 2013, under the development tax credit (32.100–32.125), rebuilding communities (135.535), enhanced enterprise zone (135.950–135.973), and Missouri quality jobs (620.1875–620.1890) programs, and bars simultaneous benefits under those programs or section 620.1910.

headings.title: Severability of Missouri works statutory provisions
headings.reviewNote: Provides that invalidity of any provision of sections 620.2000 to 620.2020 shall not affect other valid applications.

headings.title: Quarterly report by department to general assembly
headings.reviewNote: Requires quarterly reports detailing qualified companies, approved benefits, jobs created, and capital investment.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority and administrative guidelines
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to adopt administrative rules, statements of policy, and forms under chapter 536.

headings.title: Sunset provisions under Missouri sunset act
headings.reviewNote: Reauthorizes sections 620.2000 to 620.2020 as of August 28, 2018, sets expiration on August 28, 2030 (twelve years if reauthorized), and sets termination on September 1 of the following year (September 1, 2031).

entries.reviewSummary: Provides administration, annual limits, verification, employee protections, quarterly reporting, and sunset provisions for the Missouri Works program.

headings.title: Establishment of Ozark exploration bicentennial commission
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the Ozark Exploration Bicentennial Commission.

headings.title: Commission composition and appointing authorities
headings.reviewNote: Specifies twelve commission members appointed by the house speaker, senate president pro tempore, and Missouri State University leadership, plus the director of the division of tourism or designee.

headings.title: Appointment deadline for commission members
headings.reviewNote: Requires all commission appointments to be completed by October 1, 2017.

headings.title: Uncompensated service and division administrative support
headings.reviewNote: Provides that commission members serve without compensation and directs the division of tourism to provide administrative support.

headings.title: Establishment of Ozark exploration bicentennial fund
headings.reviewNote: Creates the Ozark exploration bicentennial fund in the state treasury to receive appropriations and donations.

headings.title: Statutory duties and bicentennial commemoration planning
headings.reviewNote: Outlines duties to coordinate bicentennial events, promote heritage tourism, and educate the public on Ozark history.

headings.title: Dissolution of commission and statutory expiration
headings.reviewNote: Dissolves the commission and terminates statutory provisions on June 30, 2019.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the Ozark Exploration Bicentennial Commission, detailing membership, administrative support, trust fund, duties, and expiration.

headings.title: Citation of Route 66 centennial commission act
headings.reviewNote: Designates the section as the Missouri Route 66 Centennial Commission Act.

headings.title: Commission composition and member appointment
headings.reviewNote: Establishes an eighteen-member commission representing historical, preservation, tourism, and legislative interests.

headings.title: Vacancies for ex officio members
headings.reviewNote: Provides that ex officio members vacate their commission positions upon leaving their underlying official offices.

headings.title: Reimbursement for member expenses without compensation
headings.reviewNote: Provides that members serve without compensation but may be reimbursed for actual and necessary expenses.

headings.title: Quarterly meetings and transaction of business
headings.reviewNote: Requires quarterly meetings in Missouri and defines quorum requirements for official commission action.

headings.title: Statutory duties and centennial celebration activities
headings.reviewNote: Directs the commission to plan, encourage, and sponsor Route 66 centennial celebrations and economic development.

headings.title: Administrative support by office of tourism
headings.reviewNote: Directs the office of tourism, subject to appropriation, to provide administrative and other support to the commission.

headings.title: Authority to accept gifts and donations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes accepting monetary and in-kind gifts and grants, creating the Missouri Route 66 Centennial Commission Fund as a nonappropriated trust fund outside the state treasury with the state treasurer as custodian, usable for commission duties and section 226.793 signage.

headings.title: Final report to governor and commission dissolution
headings.reviewNote: Requires delivering a final report to the governor before June 30, 2030, dissolves the commission on June 30, 2030, and deposits remaining fund moneys into general revenue.

headings.title: Statutory termination date of commission
headings.reviewNote: Terminates the provisions of this section on December 1, 2030.

entries.reviewSummary: Enacts the Missouri Route 66 Centennial Commission Act, establishing membership, meetings, duties, gifts, reporting, and statutory termination.

headings.title: Citation of TIME zones act
headings.reviewNote: Designates the section as the Targeted Industrial Manufacturing Enhancement Zones Act.

headings.title: Definitions for TIME zones program
headings.reviewNote: Defines county average wage, department, facility, governing body, new job, political subdivision, and TIME zone.

headings.title: Joint creation of TIME zones authorized
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes governing bodies of contiguous political subdivisions to create joint TIME zones to promote manufacturing.

headings.title: Ordinance and public hearing requirements
headings.reviewNote: Requires participating political subdivisions to propose ordinances or resolutions and hold public hearings to establish a TIME zone, governed thereafter by a seven-member zone board.

headings.title: Specific description of zone boundaries
headings.reviewNote: Requires proposed TIME zone boundaries to be described by metes and bounds, streets, or other sufficiently specific description.

headings.title: Execution of agreement with department
headings.reviewNote: Requires the zone board to enter into a written agreement with the department before retaining withholding taxes.

headings.title: Term limitation of zone agreements
headings.reviewNote: Limits the term of agreements and withholding tax retentions to a maximum of ten years.

headings.title: Coordination with Missouri works program benefits
headings.reviewNote: Regulates interaction between TIME zone benefits and Missouri Works incentives for the same qualifying facility.

headings.title: Retention of twenty-five percent withholding taxes
headings.reviewNote: Directs deposit of twenty-five percent of withholding taxes from new jobs into the dedicated state treasury fund.

headings.title: Establishment of TIME zone fund in treasury
headings.reviewNote: Creates the TIME zone fund in the state treasury to hold retained withholding taxes for infrastructure improvements.

headings.title: Project approval and infrastructure financing by board
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the zone board to approve manufacturing projects and finance public infrastructure improvements.

headings.title: Annual reporting by zone boards to department
headings.reviewNote: Requires zone boards to submit annual financial reports and project assessments to the department.

headings.title: Prohibition on overlapping advanced industrial manufacturing zones
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits political subdivisions from establishing a TIME zone whose boundaries overlap an advanced industrial manufacturing zone established under section 68.075.

headings.title: Annual statewide withholding retention cap
headings.reviewNote: Caps total withholding taxes retained by all TIME zones statewide at five million dollars per fiscal year.

headings.title: Rulemaking authority for TIME zones
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to promulgate administrative rules to implement the program under chapter 536.

headings.title: Sunset on establishment of new TIME zones
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits the establishment of new TIME zones after August 28, 2025, while continuing existing zones.

entries.reviewSummary: Enacts the Targeted Industrial Manufacturing Enhancement Zones Act, governing joint creation, withholding retention, infrastructure financing, and sunset.

headings.title: Definitions for industrial biomass renewable energy
headings.reviewNote: Defines biomass facility, department, park, and renewable energy resources for industrial energy projects.

headings.title: Application procedure for biomass park project
headings.reviewNote: Sets application procedures for industrial park owners seeking renewable energy project certification from the department.

headings.title: Renewable energy portfolio standard compliance
headings.reviewNote: Directs the public service commission to assign double credit toward renewable energy portfolio standards for electric power, renewable energy, or renewable energy credits generated from qualifying park biomass or storage equipment.

entries.reviewSummary: Defines industrial biomass renewable energy park projects, establishing application procedures and renewable portfolio compliance.

headings.title: Establishment of virtual entrepreneur resource network
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the Missouri Entrepreneur Resource Virtual Network managed by small business development centers.

headings.title: Required informational sections and business resources
headings.reviewNote: Requires prominent home-page sections covering considering starting, starting, expanding, relocating from another state, and relocating from another country to Missouri, with search engine optimization.

headings.title: State information systems and security compliance
headings.reviewNote: Requires network systems interfacing with state websites to comply with state information technology standards.

headings.title: Reporting requirements to legislative committees
headings.reviewNote: Requires small business development centers to report network progress and metrics to legislative committees by September 30, 2012.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the Missouri Entrepreneur Resource Virtual Network (MERVN), detailing resource requirements, IT standards, and legislative reporting.

headings.title: Establishment of broadband internet grant program
headings.reviewNote: Establishes a grant program administered by the department to expand broadband internet service in unserved and underserved areas.

headings.title: Definitions of unserved and underserved areas
headings.reviewNote: Defines project, underserved area, and unserved area based on upload and download speed thresholds.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the broadband internet grant program, designating the department as administrator and defining speed thresholds.

headings.title: Permissible grant uses and speed standards
headings.reviewNote: Requires grant funds to be used for broadband installation, prioritizing speeds of at least 100 Mbps download and upload or FCC standards.

headings.title: Recordkeeping for federal rural broadband grants
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to track federal broadband grants and reallocate unspent funds to qualified Missouri providers.

headings.title: Specific use of grant moneys and repayment remedies
headings.reviewNote: Requires entities to use funds solely for grant purposes and mandates repayment of misspent or unexpended funds.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs broadband grant fund expenditures, speed prioritization, tracking of federal grants, and repayment remedies.

headings.title: Publication of criteria and scoring system
headings.reviewNote: Requires department website publication of evaluation criteria and quantitative scoring scheme thirty days before application submission.

headings.title: Publication of proposed areas and speeds
headings.reviewNote: Directs publication of proposed unserved and underserved areas and speeds within three days of application close.

headings.title: Written challenge by existing broadband provider
headings.reviewNote: Allows existing or adjacent broadband providers forty-five days to challenge applications based on current or planned service.

headings.title: Applicant notification of challenge submission
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department to notify grant applicants within three business days of receiving a written challenge.

headings.title: Evaluation and standard for challenge determination
headings.reviewNote: Directs evaluation of challenges and prohibits funding if the provider currently provides or commits to provide qualifying speeds.

headings.title: Penalty for unfulfilled broadband commitment
headings.reviewNote: Bars challenging providers who fail to fulfill broadband commitments from challenging applications for two subsequent grant cycles.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes scoring criteria publication, notice of proposed broadband areas, provider challenge procedures, and nonperformance penalties.

headings.title: First priority for unserved areas
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to give first priority to grant applications that serve unserved areas.

headings.title: Secondary priority for matching funds in unserved areas
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to give secondary priority to applications demonstrating the ability to receive government or other matching funds serving unserved areas.

headings.title: Third priority for underserved area applications
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to give third priority to grant applications that serve underserved areas.

headings.title: Quantitative scoring system and eleven ranking elements
headings.reviewNote: Requires a quantitative weighting or scoring system evaluating eleven minimum elements, including applicant capability, cost efficiency, speeds, scalability, fifty percent private funding commitment, operating history, community institutions, economic distress, training, adoption plans, and community support.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes three priority tiers and a quantitative eleven-element scoring system for ranking broadband internet grant applications.

headings.title: Ineligibility for areas with federal universal funding
headings.reviewNote: Disqualifies project areas receiving Connect America or high-cost universal service funds without matching requirements.

headings.title: Maximum fifty percent total project funding
headings.reviewNote: Limits combined federal, state, and local grant funding to no more than fifty percent of total project cost.

headings.title: Five million dollar cap per project
headings.reviewNote: Caps cumulative grant awards for any single project at five million dollars.

headings.title: Geographic distribution of grant awards
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to endeavor to award broadband grants across all regions of the state.

headings.title: Regulatory restrictions on grant conditions
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits open access mandates, discriminatory service conditions, and extra-statutory rate regulation.

headings.title: Repayment required for failure to meet speeds
headings.reviewNote: Requires grant recipients to return all grant moneys to the department if established speed requirements are not met.

entries.reviewSummary: Sets grant eligibility restrictions, funding caps, geographic distribution goals, regulatory limits, and repayment remedies.

headings.title: Implementation of broadband access program
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to implement a program to increase high-speed internet access in unserved and underserved areas.

headings.title: Promulgation of administrative rules
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to promulgate administrative rules to implement the broadband access program under chapter 536.

entries.reviewSummary: Directs the department to implement a high-speed broadband program in underserved areas and authorizes rulemaking.

headings.title: Definitions for major aerospace projects
headings.reviewNote: Defines aerospace project (NAICS 3364 creating at least two thousand new jobs within ten years with a proposal on or before June 10, 2014) and job creation, worker training, and infrastructure development programs.

headings.title: Exemption from aggregate caps and annual limit
headings.reviewNote: Excludes aerospace project benefits from aggregate limits under sections 99.845, 100.850, 620.809, and 620.2020, while capping total annual state benefits for an aerospace project at one hundred fifty million dollars; source footnote notes reference to subsection 8 of 620.809 was renumbered to 9 in 2022.

headings.title: Annual department report on benefits and training
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to deliver an annual report to the general assembly detailing state benefits received and projected for the aerospace project and the number of minorities trained under Missouri one start.

headings.title: Annual project report on diversity outreach
headings.reviewNote: Requires any aerospace project receiving benefits under this section to annually report its minority and women employment outreach efforts to the general assembly and department.

headings.title: Restriction on TIF bond disbursements
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits disbursing new state revenues under sections 99.800 to 99.865 to satisfy bond obligations incurred for improvements that do not directly benefit the aerospace project.

headings.title: Tenth-year net fiscal benefit determination
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department in the tenth year after notice approval to determine the state's net fiscal benefit and take necessary action to ensure a positive net fiscal benefit by the final benefit year.

entries.reviewSummary: Excludes qualifying aerospace project benefits from aggregate program caps up to one hundred fifty million dollars annually, mandates benefit and outreach reports, restricts TIF bond disbursements, and requires a tenth-year net fiscal benefit review.

headings.title: Definitions for upskill credential program
headings.reviewNote: Defines employee, qualifying employer, and upskill credential for the workforce training reimbursement program.

headings.title: Reimbursement distribution to qualifying employers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to distribute reimbursements up to statutory caps to employers for employee credential training costs.

headings.title: Application form design and requirements
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to design application procedures and establish documentation guidelines for qualifying employers.

headings.title: Establishment of upskill credential training fund
headings.reviewNote: Creates the Upskill Credential Training Fund in the state treasury consisting of appropriations up to six million dollars per fiscal year, exempt from section 33.080 biennial reversion.

headings.title: Application evaluation and ranking criteria
headings.reviewNote: Establishes department evaluation standards prioritizing high-need industries and credentials leading to wage increases.

headings.title: Preliminary award and proof of completion
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes preliminary award commitments with final reimbursement paid upon proof of successful credential completion.

headings.title: Ineligibility of training providers for awards
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits training providers from receiving reimbursement awards unless their own direct employees are trained.

headings.title: Restrictions on employee reimbursement awards
headings.reviewNote: Bars a qualifying employer from receiving upskill funds for a credential if the employer receives Missouri one start funds or the employee receives a fast track workforce incentive grant for the same credential.

headings.title: Promulgation of administrative rules
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to promulgate administrative rules to administer the upskill credential training program.

headings.title: Sunset provisions under Missouri sunset act
headings.reviewNote: Sets automatic program sunset six years after August 28, 2023 (August 28, 2029), twelve years if reauthorized, and termination on September 1 of the following calendar year (September 1, 2030).

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the upskill credential training program and fund, detailing employer reimbursements, criteria, and sunset terms.

headings.title: Citation of Innovation Campus Tax Credit Act
headings.reviewNote: Designates the statutory section as the Innovation Campus Tax Credit Act.

headings.title: Definitions for innovation campus credits
headings.reviewNote: Defines certificate, department, eligible donation, innovation education campus (or innovation campus), and taxpayer.

headings.title: Authorization of tax credit for contributions
headings.reviewNote: For taxable years beginning on or after January 1, 2015, allows a nonrefundable fifty percent tax credit for eligible donations with four-year carryforward; source footnote notes 'a' appears in H.B. 1459, 2014.

headings.title: Application procedure and credit certificate
headings.reviewNote: Sets application procedures for innovation campuses to verify contributions and issue tax credit certificates.

headings.title: Transfer, sale, or assignment of credits
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the transfer, sale, or assignment of innovation campus tax credits by notarized endorsement.

headings.title: Promulgation of administrative rules
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to adopt administrative rules to implement the tax credit program under chapter 536.

headings.title: Sunset provisions under Missouri sunset act
headings.reviewNote: Sets program expiration six years after August 28, 2014 (August 28, 2020), twelve-year sunset if reauthorized, and termination on September 1 of the following year (September 1, 2021).

entries.reviewSummary: Enacts the Innovation Campus Tax Credit Act, authorizing tax credits for contributions, detailing transferability, and setting sunset terms.

headings.title: Citation of Capitol Complex Tax Credit Act
headings.reviewNote: Designates the statutory section as the Capitol Complex Tax Credit Act.

headings.title: Definitions for capitol complex tax credits
headings.reviewNote: Defines board, capitol complex, certificate, department, eligible artifact, eligible artifact donation, eligible monetary donation, eligible recipient, and qualified donor; source footnote notes 'Service' appears in original rolls.

headings.title: Establishment of Capitol Complex Fund
headings.reviewNote: Creates the Capitol Complex Fund held by the Missouri development finance board for restoration and preservation.

headings.title: Tax credit for eligible monetary donations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes a tax credit equal to fifty percent of eligible monetary donations made to the Capitol Complex Fund.

headings.title: Tax credit for eligible artifact donations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes a tax credit equal to thirty percent of the appraised value of eligible artifact donations.

headings.title: Application for monetary donation tax credit
headings.reviewNote: Specifies application procedures and documentation required to claim credits for monetary donations.

headings.title: Application for artifact donation tax credit
headings.reviewNote: Specifies appraisal requirements and application procedures to claim credits for donated historic artifacts.

headings.title: Annual ten million dollar authorization cap
headings.reviewNote: Caps cumulative tax credit authorizations under this section at ten million dollars in any calendar year, processed first-come, first-served with waitlist or return options for excess donations.

headings.title: Exemption from department issuance fees
headings.reviewNote: Exempts tax credits issued under this section from the tax credit fee authorized in section 620.1900.

headings.title: Transfer, sale, or assignment of credits
headings.reviewNote: Permits the transfer, sale, or assignment of capitol complex tax credits by notarized endorsement.

headings.title: Promulgation of administrative rules
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to adopt administrative rules to implement the credit program under chapter 536.

headings.title: Sunset provisions under Missouri sunset act
headings.reviewNote: Sets automatic sunset six years after August 28, 2021 (August 28, 2027), twelve years if reauthorized, and termination on September 1 of the following year (September 1, 2028).

entries.reviewSummary: Enacts the Capitol Complex Tax Credit Act, authorizing donation tax credits, establishing the fund, and setting annual caps and sunset terms.

headings.title: Completion of boots-to-business program by veterans
headings.reviewNote: Permits any veteran receiving a small business loan through the state treasurer's linked deposit program under sections 30.750 to 30.765 to complete a department-approved boots-to-business program.

headings.title: Assignment of mentor and quarterly meeting opportunity
headings.reviewNote: Assigns a mentor for three hundred sixty-five days following approval to veteran-owned small business owners participating in the boots-to-business program, with opportunities to meet at least once every ninety days.

headings.title: Rules approving boots-to-business and mentor programs
headings.reviewNote: Permits the department to adopt rules establishing or approving boots-to-business programs under subsection 1 and mentor programs under subsection 2.

headings.title: Promulgation of administrative rules
headings.reviewNote: Conditions effectiveness of rules under this section on chapter 536 compliance and nonseverability clauses for rules proposed or adopted after August 28, 2018.

entries.reviewSummary: Authorizes veteran recipients of linked deposit small business loans to complete approved boots-to-business programs, provides one-year mentor assignments, and grants department rulemaking authority.

headings.title: Citation of Military Community Reinvestment Act
headings.reviewNote: Designates the section as the Missouri Military Community Reinvestment Program Act.

headings.title: Definitions for military community reinvestment
headings.reviewNote: Defines commission, department, eligible applicant, grant, military installation, and program.

headings.title: Establishment of community reinvestment program
headings.reviewNote: Establishes the Missouri military community reinvestment program in the department to assist defense communities.

headings.title: Establishment of reinvestment grant program fund
headings.reviewNote: Creates the Missouri military community reinvestment grant program fund in the state treasury without biennial lapse.

headings.title: Program implementation and public comment
headings.reviewNote: Directs joint development of application procedures by the department and military preparedness commission with public input.

headings.title: Application evaluation and award administration
headings.reviewNote: Outlines department evaluation, commission approval authority, and award monitoring responsibilities.

headings.title: Grant funding limits and match requirements
headings.reviewNote: Caps annual grants at three hundred thousand dollars and establishes matching fund ratios based on applicant operating history.

headings.title: Required coordinated program of work activities
headings.reviewNote: Specifies allowable grant activities including public partnerships, marketing, economic diversification, and reuse planning.

headings.title: Promulgation of administrative rules
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the department to promulgate administrative rules to implement the reinvestment program under chapter 536.

entries.reviewSummary: Enacts the Missouri Military Community Reinvestment Program Act, establishing grant funds, matching requirements, and allowable activities.

headings.title: Veterans and job opportunity program established
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to establish the Missouri veterans and job opportunity grant program subject to appropriations.

headings.title: Definitions for veterans opportunity program
headings.reviewNote: Defines eligible employer, grant, and targeted groups incorporating federal work opportunity tax credit standards.

headings.title: Veterans job opportunity program fund created
headings.reviewNote: Creates the dedicated state treasury fund to hold appropriations and gifts without biennial reversion.

headings.title: Grant administration and veteran reservation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes grant disbursements based on federal tax credits and reserves at least fifty percent for hiring qualified veterans.

headings.title: Promulgation of administrative rules
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to promulgate all necessary administrative rules under chapter 536 with nonseverability provisions for rules proposed or adopted after August 28, 2024.

entries.reviewSummary: Establishes the Missouri Veterans and Job Opportunity Grant Program, defining terms, creating a dedicated fund, and setting veteran hiring reservations.

headings.title: Application for rural fund equity certification
headings.reviewNote: Requires rural funds seeking capital investment certification to apply (applications opening within ninety days of August 28, 2024) with federal RBIC/SBIC license, one hundred million dollar rural and thirty million dollar Missouri investment evidence, ten-year revenue impact business plan, and five thousand dollar nonrefundable fee.

headings.title: Department decision timeline within sixty days
headings.reviewNote: Directs the department to approve or deny completed rural fund capital investment applications within sixty days.

headings.title: Notice of grounds for application denial
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department to provide detailed written grounds for denial and allow applicants fifteen days to cure defects.

headings.title: Certification of proposed capital investments
headings.reviewNote: Directs certification of equity investments as capital investments and sets statewide allocation limits.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs application procedures, review deadlines, denial notices, and certifications for rural fund capital investments.

headings.title: Annual credit cap and ninety-day investment issuance
headings.reviewNote: Caps annual state tax credits at sixteen million dollars excluding carryforwards, requires rural funds to issue capital investments and receive cash (at least ten percent affiliate capital) within ninety days of certification, and requires evidence within ninety-five days.

headings.title: Lapse and reallocation of unissued authority
headings.reviewNote: Provides that unissued capital investment authority lapses and is reallocated pro rata among other certified funds.

headings.title: Written opinion on qualified business eligibility
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes rural funds to request written determinations from the department regarding proposed business investments.

entries.reviewSummary: Specifies investment issuance timelines, forfeiture of unused authority, and formal eligibility determination opinions.

headings.title: Vested right to rural fund tax credits
headings.reviewNote: Grants rural investors a vested right to earn tax credits equal to the applicable percentage multiplied by purchase price on each credit allowance date, with five-year carryforward and no carryback.

headings.title: Nonrefundable and nonassignable credit limits
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits refunding or selling credits on the open market while permitting allocation to partners, members, or shareholders of partnerships, LLCs, or S-corporations with department notice.

headings.title: Grounds for tax credit recapture
headings.reviewNote: Outlines statutory grounds for recapturing tax credits, including failure to invest capital or exit distributions.

headings.title: Notice of noncompliance and cure period
headings.reviewNote: Requires the department to provide written notice of noncompliance and grant six months to cure before recapturing credits.

entries.reviewSummary: Governs tax credit earning schedules, nonrefundable limitations, recapture grounds, and statutory cure periods for rural investments.

headings.title: Annual reporting by participating rural funds
headings.reviewNote: Requires rural funds to submit annual reports detailing qualified investments, bank statements, and job metrics.

headings.title: Status as business recruitment program
headings.reviewNote: Classifies the rural fund program as a business recruitment tax credit under section 135.800 subject to sections 135.800 to 135.830; source footnote notes subdivision (4) appears in original rolls.

headings.title: Application to exit program after six years
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes rural funds to apply for formal exit from the program six years after the initial credit allowance date.

headings.title: State profit sharing upon program exit
headings.reviewNote: Establishes state profit sharing mechanics for distributions exceeding invested capital upon program exit.

headings.title: Sunset provisions under Missouri sunset act
headings.reviewNote: Sets program expiration six years after August 28, 2024 (August 28, 2030), termination on September 1 of the following year (September 1, 2031), six-year sunset if reauthorized, and preserves prior certified authority.

headings.title: Promulgation of administrative rules
headings.reviewNote: Permits the department to adopt implementing rules, policies, and forms under chapter 536 with nonseverability provisions for rules proposed or adopted after August 28, 2024.
